summary: Authored a 3-phase, 3-hour implementation plan for re-anchoring validate-state.sh's omitted-argument STATE_FILE default to the git toplevel of the script's own location via upward .git marker discovery, with a loud exit-2 refusal when SCRIPT_DIR is not in a work tree. Phase 1 edits the default block, adds success-path absolute-path canonicalization before the existing banner, and revises the header/--help contract; Phase 2 adds two non-vacuous suite cases (cross-repo omitted-argument, plus an explicit-argument argument-relativity regression run from a foreign CWD) behind a source-store-first grep-gated validator resolution; Phase 3 redeploys and runs the full gate set including gate 10. All anchors were re-derived by content grep at plan-authoring time because two footprint-colliding tasks will shift line numbers.

artifacts.summary: 3-phase plan: script-anchored default resolution plus absolute banner, two non-vacuous regression cases, redeploy and full gate set.
